shortDescription: German satellite maker OHB XETR:OHB said on Monday it had signed a contract worth nearly €1 billion ($1.17 billion) with European satellite operator SES to develop and produce 18 medium-Earth-orbit satellite platforms.The satellites will form a core part of the IRIS network, Europe's planned multi…

children: said on Monday it had signed a contract worth nearly €1 billion ($1.17 billion) with European satellite operator SES to develop and produce 18 medium-Earth-orbit satellite platforms.
The satellites will form a core part of the IRIS network, Europe's planned multi-orbit communications constellation designed to provide secure and resilient satellite services, it added.

title: German satellite maker OHB wins $1.2 bln contract for 18 satellites in EU network
